input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Section 2(a) grant runs to "Client" alone, and nothing in Section 2(b) scope (p0025-p0027), the definitions or Section 8(c) (which merely lets Client restrict access to "its officers, employees, and agents") extends use to our affiliates, whether automatically or on written notice. Section 15 (p0080) also bars any assignment or transfer of rights without TrueLink's prior written approval, with the sole carve-out being an assignment to "a financially responsible affiliate" — an acquirer or surviving entity in an M&A transaction is not covered, so the licence cannot follow us into a merger or acquisition. Both fallback elements therefore fail on material terms, which is a deviation rather than a preferred-wording shortfall. We target the fallback, not preferred: this is a term licence lasting "until this Agreement is terminated" (p0028) with no paid-up fee, so perpetual/irrevocable language is not the right ask, and contractor use is at least partially recognised through the "agents" language in Section 8(c). Positively, the grant is not expressed as revocable at TrueLink's discretion, so this is not walk-away territory. The redline makes the two smallest changes needed: affiliates covered on written notice in the grant, and an M&A successor carve-out in the assignment clause (left one-way in our favour).

proposal.summary: Extend the licence to Client's affiliates on written notice and permit transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our licence baseline requires affiliate coverage and a successor transfer right, so we have extended the Section 2(a) grant to our affiliates upon written notice to TrueLink and carved a transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition out of the Section 15 consent requirement.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client and, upon written notice to TrueLink, its affiliates a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of their business

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or, in the case of Client, to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
